object_description: upright faceted corner volume under a folded, downward-sloping roof
geometry_property: concentric plan around a central hall
design_condition: the volume is placed at the very top on the periphery of the perimeter to mark the corner, opening the view from the station to the village and nesting a childrens garden in the hollow of its form

positive: Placing the volume at the corner strongly marks it as an institution
The four storeys are skilfully concealed by a folded, downward-sloping roof so only three read from outside
Locating the future school at mid-height preserves a generous green space in the centre and forms a coherent complex with the existing buildings
The clear corner choice fully opens up the view from the station to the village
It initiates a pedestrian route downwards through a public park
The open-air parking under the trees and the widened street seem straightforward
The easement path runs below the building, delimiting a garden nestled in the hollow of the form
The vertical distribution of the programme is not without its advantages
The massing has the force of a sign, marking the role of the institution
Construction costs are about average with good energy and environmental characteristics
The project can be complied with in terms of fire protection
A high degree of accuracy in the consideration of the site
negative: The relevance of such a small school on four levels will have to be questioned
The public park route deserves a little more attention
It is a long way down from the upper floors to the garden, which is probably not large enough for all ages
The position adjacent to the station square offers no possibility of a second outdoor extension for the upper floors
Having to pass through the central hall breaks the unity of groups traversed by the flow of others
The sanitary facilities behind the lift are too hidden and too far from the living areas
Little information is given on materialisation and architectural expression, which appears deliberately monolithic and abstract
There are a number of weaknesses in the interior organisation, particularly in the nursery unit
